neighbours.label: A digit right after a determiner ('a', 'the', 'this', 'its') in the slot where a describing word would go, as in 'a 2-hour drive', 'this 3-day festival', 'a 12 percent rise', 'a 9 on his jersey' (whether a hyphen follows does not matter), or right after 'and'/'to' when a measure came just before ('4-hour and 90 minute limits', '20- to 40-year-old'); it peaks on the digit (the last digit of 30 or 90). Spelled-out numbers are unreliable. Quiet: digits after verbs, 'is' or prepositions ('bought 2 apples', 'for 2 hours', 'is 7', 'in 2010'), plain counts and years.
neighbours.short: digit right after a determiner ('a 2-hour drive')
